# MineVault - Minecraft Schematics & Builds Repository

> MineVault is a free, high-performance community web repository providing verified Minecraft structures, blueprints, and build downloads in Sponge WorldEdit (.schem), Litematica (.litematic), and vanilla World Save (.zip) formats.

## Key Features
- Verified compatibility across Minecraft Java editions 1.18 to 1.21.4.
- Exact 3D bounding box dimensions (width X, height Y, length Z).
- Full block count metrics and survival materials checklists (converted into 64-item stacks).
- Multi-angle in-game screenshot galleries (Daytime, Shaders Night, Interior, Redstone Circuitry).
- Direct console import command helpers (`//schem load <filename>` and `//paste -a`).

## Master Catalog & Endpoints
- Homepage: https://yourusername.github.io/minecraft-schematics/
- Schematics Dataset: https://yourusername.github.io/minecraft-schematics/data/schematics.json
- Raw Downloads Directory: https://yourusername.github.io/minecraft-schematics/downloads/

## Included Builds
- Aethelgard Medieval Fortress (Castles, 14,200 blocks, 1.20+)
- Neo-Tokyo Cyberpunk Skyscraper (Sci-Fi, 26,800 blocks, 1.21+)
- Cherry Blossom Zen Pagoda (Oriental, 8,950 blocks, 1.20+)
- Seamless 4x4 Piston Vault Door (Redstone, 420 blocks, 1.19-1.21)
- Cozy Survival Cottage & Greenhouse (Survival Bases, 3,400 blocks, 1.18+)
- Nether Bastion Overhaul & Gold Farm (Megabuilds, 48,000 blocks, 1.20+)
